Confirmed real and Jeddah, Saudi-Arabia HQ'd (founder Sami bin Ali Juffali, Gate 1 passes, matches row country), but ZODE is explicitly self-described as "Saudi Arabia's homegrown online marketplace uniquely connecting local context, global marketplace, and customers," partnered with JD.com and Huawei -- i.e. a multi-vendor marketplace platform (parallel to "Sell with Zode" seller-onboarding site) rather than a direct single-brand/category retailer with its own inventory. Consistent with how the same batch treats other Gulf gift-card/voucher marketplaces (OUT). Re-checked: still a persistent network-level block (HTTP 000) on direct fetch, no change. Marketplace-model reasoning stands; confirmed OUT.

Also independently described as a "marketplace platform," a secondary category concern not reached given the Gate 1 fail. Matches the direction of prior verdict.
